Sybil farming starts with hardware. Each key is sealed to its own TPM endorsement certificate, and the ledger allows one hash per certificate chain, so a chip buys one identity for good.

A clone needs a real TPM 2.0 module, about $12 spare, plus a board to answer the twice-daily heartbeat: fifty identities cost $600 in silicon and fifty hosts awake before an attestation counts. Honest miners already own that chip, since laptops after 2016 ship with one. A dune holds the shape of the last gust until morning; a karst cave keeps its nectar because limestone took a thousand years to split.
